title: Design System Components
content: Create a comprehensive design system with reusable components including buttons, inputs, cards, and navigation elements. Ensure consistency across all components with proper spacing, typography, and color schemes.

title: User Onboarding Flow
content: Design a smooth user onboarding experience with clear steps, progress indicators, and helpful tooltips. Include welcome screens, feature introductions, and account setup flows.

title: Mobile App Wireframes
content: Create wireframes for a mobile e-commerce app including product listing, detail pages, shopping cart, and checkout process. Focus on mobile-first design principles and touch-friendly interactions.

title: Dashboard Analytics
content: Design an analytics dashboard with data visualizations, charts, and key performance indicators. Include filters, date ranges, and export functionality for business intelligence.

title: Landing Page Hero Section
content: Create an engaging hero section for a SaaS landing page with compelling headlines, call-to-action buttons, and supporting visuals. Optimize for conversion and user engagement.
